title: UserBench gold_acts annotator (MVP)

taxonomy.approve: greenlight the agent's proposal — go ahead / LGTM; no new task
taxonomy.critical: asserts something is WRONG — bug/failure/wrong output, or approach mistaken
taxonomy.steer: assigns a NEW or DIFFERENT task from what the agent just proposed (not mere go-ahead)
taxonomy.inquiry: goal is an answer/explanation, not asking the agent to do work

notes: Blind free multi-label. Approve = proceed with agent's proposal; steer = new/different ask. Primary metrics: Jaccard + per-label κ. Filter: drop compaction/continuation summaries as targets (prefix "This session is being continued…" / ran-out-of-context summary). Replaced v2:t010 with v2:t087 (2026-07-22).

compaction_filter.rule: skip harness compaction continuation summaries as labeling/prediction targets
